}}<section end="seo" />
<section begin="infobox" />{{Infobox dlc pack

<% } -%>

|skin_count=<%= it.skinCount %>
<% } -%>
}}<section end="infobox" />

<%~ it.skinsSection -%>
<section end="skins" />
<% } -%>
